target_brief: Full frozen A/B corridor along the water-covered strip beside the eastern vegetated bank.
notes: Floodwater covers the putative road for the full A/B interval. The exposed bank and nearby poles do not establish both road edges or complete terminal cross-sections. No physical road obstruction can be localized reliably.
uncertainties: The road surface, western road edge and both complete road cross-sections are hidden by floodwater; full target width cannot be traced.

notes: The lower and middle open road appears clear. Two ordinary cars are on the side branch near A and are not treated as obstacles. Tree crowns and dark shadow conceal part of the eastern road margin in the upper half; the full-width target cannot be verified.
uncertainties: Eastern road edge and adjacent surface are hidden by tree canopy/shadow at approximately y=0.23-0.44; an unobstructed complete road width cannot be established there.

No confirmed physical obstacle is visible inside the full target; patches, wires and roadside vegetation are not localized as road obstructions.

target_brief: Whole north-south road from upper junction A to lower junction B, including both full terminal cross-sections.

Vegetation height and ground-level contact cannot be determined from this overhead view.

target_brief: Entire north-south main road from lower crossroad A to upper crossroad B, keeping main-road width across driveways.

The overlapping leaves do not establish a ground-level vegetation obstruction.

target_brief: Full diagonal frozen road corridor from upper-right A to lower-left B beside the electrical facility and parking area.

Membership of the visible fallen vegetation in the full road target cannot be confirmed without the hidden boundaries.

notes: Native crop inspection distinguishes tree shadows from physical material and preserves readable road edges through the shaded sections. Both full terminal cross-sections and continuous main-road width at the driveways are readable. No confirmed physical obstacle is present within A/B.

target_brief: Entire eastward road from western junction A to frozen B in the tree-lined section.
